result:
Not every screen reached 4. I shipped one change this run, v30.30, and the critic scored the pause card (49) and the How to play card (46) 3 out of 5. I ran the critic only on those two; the other eleven screens have no score from this run.

- **What shipped:** I removed the plain "Esc Resume" hint from the pause card. The critic had asked for this twice, and the X in the header already shows close.
- **Tests:** Two older pause checks, 29.56 and 29.57, required that hint. I retargeted them, and the card now only has to leave 32px under the last button. Preflight and the ship gate passed, and the seed 4242 fingerprint did not move.
- **Pictures:** Before and after shots for all 13 screens are in `shots/12-j1` and `shots/12-j2`.
- **Critic on 49:** it scored 3, "same" as before. Its main complaints are the dimmed HUD and the How to play panel still showing behind the card, and no visible focus state on the ghost buttons.
- **Critic on 46:** it scored 3. It wants a close X in the header and a real primary button in the footer instead of the "Press any button" line.
- **Left undone:**
  - The dimmed world behind the pause and operator cards. Check 29.88 requires a solid scrim, so this needs a ruling from you.
  - The close X and the footer button on screen 46.
  - The focus state on the pause ghost buttons.
  - "No scores yet" still renders too bright on 56 and 64.
  - 47, 48, 53 and 54 are in-raid HUD stages, which the HUD task owns. 58 is the title page, which another task owns.

I logged the change in `changes.md` and `index.html`, and the plan for the next run is in `notes/12-ui-party-screens.md`.

TASK PARTIAL: no listed screen has reached 4. The critic gave 3 to 46 and 49 (same as before), and 56 and 62 got 3 in run 9. Next: the 46 close X and footer button, the 49 focus state, and the 56/64 "No scores yet" colour.
